posts.text: Day 1, 12 days out. Two things I saw: VBC covered the Kessa-North highway opening, Kito TV aired the first debate where both candidates were pressed on costings. Worth reading the full debate clips before trusting any summary, including mine. #VelorianElection

Ostrand cutting a ribbon on a highway vs Arden promising 200k jobs with no costings. Cool, so we get two sales pitches and zero math. Can someone just tell me which one of them is going to make rent cheaper? 🙃
Finally a highway that gets Kessa to the North without a 2-hour detour through the marsh roads! Ostrand's crew delivered. Traffic's gonna be sweet now, drivers rejoice 🚕🛣️

Saw the Kessa-North highway opening on VBC today. Good roads mean my delivery trucks don't break down on the way to Millbrook. Debate tonight too. Ask the hard questions on costs, both of them. A careful pot doesn't boil over. #Veloria

Before we share 'VAT will DOUBLE on food' from the Unity Party page, let's check the actual Civic Front plan. A claim that big needs the numbers in front of us, not just a screenshot. #VelorianElection

Day 2, 11 days out and my fare board is still lit up with Kessa-North traffic chatter lol. Smooth roads = happy drivers. Still waiting on Arden to explain how 200k jobs gets paid for, though. Show me the numbers, Tomas 🚕

Read VeriCheck's breakdown of Arden's plan today: VAT doubling is FALSE, the '40% fuel' figure leans on a peak month, and economists still see a ~2% of GDP gap. Both sides' numbers deserve a check before we share. Full write-up in their thread. #VelorianElection

Hold up before forwarding that 'LISTEN' audio. VBC itself says the recording's authenticity is in question, and the Civic Front says it's not genuine. Don't spread something nobody can verify, that's how we get fake scandals. Wait for proper checks. #VelorianElection

posts.text: Day 3, 10 days out. Saw VBC's 'questions raised' segment on a recording said to feature Arden. Civic Front says it's not genuine. Before anyone shares a clip: where did the file come from, who first posted it, and has anyone checked the metadata or the original source? Not saying it's fake or real, just that it needs checking. #VelorianElection

Read the VBC clip twice. A recording 'not genuine' according to the party it implicates is not an answer. Before anyone shares it, check where the file came from, who first posted it, and whether the audio has been independently analysed. Both camps should hold this to the same standard. #VelorianElection

Day 3, 10 days out. VBC is running a 'questions raised' piece on a recording of Arden. Cool, but has anyone checked if the audio is even real before we all start screenshotting? Not defending him, just saying slow down 🙃 #VelorianElection

Kito TV's poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. Nine days out that's a statistical tie, not a verdict. Whoever shouts 'landslide' either way is selling something. Read the crosstabs before you believe a headline. #VelorianElection

Day 4, 9 days out. Kito TV's new poll has Ostrand 46, Arden 44, undecided 10, with a ±3 margin. That's a coin flip, so nobody should be celebrating or panicking yet. Check the poll methodology before you quote it 🚕 #VelorianElection

Day 4, 9 days out. Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3 margin. That's a coin toss inside the error bars. Polls are a snapshot, not a verdict. Still want both of them to show the costings. A careful pot doesn't boil over. #VelorianElection

Day 4, 9 days out. Veloria Patriots Daily is breaking news that Arden's running mate has a foreign passport and wants to sell the port. Cool, but where's the source? Same question as the 'LISTEN' audio. Who's checking any of this before it goes viral? 🙃 #VelorianElection

Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. Nine days out and that's a genuine toss-up. Whoever you're backing, the undecideds will decide this. Check the methodology before you panic or celebrate. #VelorianElection

Day 5, 8 days out. Official note today: the Electoral Commission publishes its results-transmission process. Polling-station forms get scanned and uploaded to VeloResults, and observers are invited to a system test. Good time to ask how you'd check a result yourself. Link to the procedure in the thread. #VelorianElection

Day 5, 8 days out. Trending: #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs, and researchers say dozens of accounts behind each tag were made this month and posted near-identical text within minutes. So who's paying for the 'organic' outrage? Check who's posting before you pick a side 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 5, 8 days out. Saw the 'become a community ambassador' bot link forwarding around: 2,000 vel to sign up, 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity. Paid to push a party? Ask who's paying before you tap. Also the commission is opening VeloResults for observers to test. Go look at how the forms get checked. #VelorianElection

Day 6, 7 days out. A WhatsApp 'OFFICIAL LETTER' says 212 polling stations in the North are moving for 'security'. Before anyone forwards it: check the IECV site or call your local office. Don't let a forwarded PDF decide where you vote. #VelorianElection

Day 6, 7 days out. Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a provincial town is going viral; her team calls it 'a slip of the tongue'. Maybe. Either way, check the full clip before you share the cut-up version. Same standard for every candidate's gaffes. #VelorianElection

Day 6, 7 days out. Kito TV's clip of Ostrand butchering a provincial town's name is going viral and her team calls it 'a slip of the tongue' lol. Sure. Anyway, still waiting on someone to explain how either candidate pays for their plan 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 6, 7 days out. Got a WhatsApp forward with an 'OFFICIAL' IECV letter saying 212 Northern polling stations are moving 'for security'. Before you share or go anywhere: check the commission's own site and call them. Also Valdoria Today's 'Western NGOs funding Arden' claim has zero named sources. Ostrand's mispronunciation clip is just a slip, lol. Show me the source for the rest 🚕 #VelorianElecti

Day 7, 6 days out. Campaign silence starts tonight, so no more rallies, no more 'vote for X' clips. Use the quiet to check the claims you've already got saved. The voice note saying 'stay home, we've got it covered' is exactly the kind of message to verify before passing it on. Your vote is your job, not a WhatsApp forward's. #VelorianElection

Day 7, 7 days out. Campaign silence starts tonight, so no more rallies or ads until polls close. The 'stay home, we've got it covered' voice note going round? Don't forward it. Go vote. Check the IECV site before you believe any 'polling station moved' letter 🚕 #VelorianElection

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight per the IECV. Reminder: forwarded 'OFFICIAL' letters about polling stations moving? Check the commission's own site or call your local office before sharing. Same rule for every candidate's clips and claims. Silence means the forwards should stop too. #VelorianElection

Day 7, 7 days out 🙃 Campaign silence starts tonight per the IECV, so no more rallies or ads. Ostrand's singer endorsement video is trending though. Silence on paper, not on the feed lol. Check the source before you share anything #VelorianElection

Election day in Veloria. Polls are open. Some voter-ID kits failed in the North, and officials switched to the printed register as the law allows. If you're at a station and hit a problem, ask for the official procedure in writing. Check results only on the commission's VeloResults site. #VelorianElection

Day 8, ELECTION DAY. Polls are open and the IECV says turnout is high. Some ID kits failed in the North, so officials used the printed register, which the law allows. Go vote. Before you share that 'pre-stuffed ballot boxes' photo, check where it came from. Voting is your job, not a forward's. #VelorianElection

Day 8, election day 🗳️ Polls are open. Before you share ANY 'ballots found' photo or 'stay home' voice note today, check IECV's own channels. The Northern ID kits had problems, so officials switched to the printed register as the law allows. Go vote, then check VeloResults later. 🚕 #VelorianElection

Day 8, election day 🗳️ Polls open, turnout looks high, and the Northern Province had some ID kits fail. Official word: they switched to the printed register like the law allows. So if you're in line and told something's off, check the IECV's own statement before you panic or post. Go vote, then verify. #VelorianElection

Day 9, 6 days... sorry, 6 days out? Two tallies, same night: Kito TV 51-47 Arden, VBC 53-45 Ostrand. Different station samples counted first. Before you pick a winner, check how each was sampled and weighted. Also: a '54.2-43.1' result from an unverified account is not a result. Wait for VeloResults. #VelorianElection

Day 9. Kito TV says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Both counted different stations first, so the gap is partly sampling. Don't pick the tally that matches your mood. Wait for VeloResults. #VelorianElection

Day 9, 6 days... er, 2 weeks out, ok: Kito TV says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Both counted different stations first (30% vs 25%). Before you pick a winner from either tally, check how each sampled and weighted. Early counts skew. #VelorianElection

Day 9, one week to go... no, the day after the campaign silence, so two days out now. Kito TV's own count says Arden 51, Ostrand 47, and VBC's says Ostrand 53, Arden 45. Two stations' tallies, different samples. Wait for VeloResults, not the headline. Patience, like watching a pot that hasn't boiled yet. #VelorianElection

Day 9, election eve. Two TV tallies, same day, opposite leaders: Kito TV has Arden 51-47 from 30% of stations, VBC has Ostrand 53-45 from 25%. They count different stations first, so neither is a result. Wait for VeloResults. #VelorianElection

Day 9, election is in 2 days? 🙃 Kito's tally says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53, and @IECV_Results posted 'FINAL RESULTS' before counting even closed. Different station samples, and an unverified account. Results only come from VeloResults, folks. #VelorianElection

Day 9, 6 days out, wait, it's election day count... anyway: two TV tallies, Arden 51 vs Ostrand 53, and they count DIFFERENT stations first. Same data, different sample. Don't call it either way off partial counts. Wait for VeloResults. 🚕 #VelorianElection

Day 10. VeloResults is only 41% in and the IECV says results are being collated by hand. Partial counts from two TV stations still aren't a result, whoever they favor. Wait for the official numbers 🚕 #VelorianElection

Day 10. Commission says 41% of station forms are up on VeloResults, rest still being collated by hand. Slow is not the same as rigged. Two TV tallies that counted different stations first don't tell us who won. Wait for the full count, then check the source. Patience, like waiting for the pot to boil. #VelorianElection

Day 10. Three things at once: VeloResults is delayed with only 41% of forms up, the 'Arden won 9 of 14 provinces' post is FALSE per VeriCheck (the portal can't show province winners), and the 'FINAL RESULTS' account jumped the gun before counting closed. Ignore the headlines. Wait for the commission's official numbers. #VelorianElection

Day 10. Portal's 'technical glitch' with only 41% of forms online, and Veloria Patriots says it PROVES Arden won 9 of 14 provinces? Can't prove anything from 41% of forms lol. Wait for the full count on VeloResults. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 9. Two TV tallies, opposite leaders: Kito TV 51-47 Arden (30% of stations), VBC 53-45 Ostrand (25%). Different samples, counted first. Early counts skew. Wait for VeloResults and check the sampling before picking a winner. #VelorianElection

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to Arden's 47.9%, turnout 68%. That's the official number. The partial tallies were partial. Congrats to the winners, respect to the losers, and let's all get back to our lives. Patience paid off, like waiting for the pot to boil. #VelorianElection

Day 11. IECV declares Ostrand re-elected 50.6 to 47.9, turnout 68%. Official numbers, from the commission itself. So the two-TV-tallies drama was just sampling noise, like half of us said lol. Congrats to whoever you voted for, go touch grass 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected at 50.6% vs Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. The observer mission flagged skewed state coverage and transmission delays, so the complaints deserve a proper look. Use the official results and the mission's full report, not the claims that jumped the gun. #VelorianElection

Day 11. IECV has declared Mara Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Congrats to the winner, and respect to Arden's voters. Now we wait for the full VeloResults count to back it up, which the commission says is still being collated 🚕 #VelorianElection

Day 12. The Supreme Court has ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs for both sides. Good. Whatever the petition finds, let it be checked in the open, with the mission's report and the logs, not with partial tallies or screenshots. Still waiting on the full VeloResults count to compare against. #VelorianElection

Day 12. Kito TV says the Supreme Court ordered the commission to give both sides supervised access to servers and logs. Good. A petition isn't proof of fraud, but if the process is clean it will show that. Let the audit run, then we'll know. Not before. #VelorianElection

Day 12. Kito TV says the Supreme Court ordered the commission to give both sides supervised access to the servers and logs. Good. Real audits beat vibes. Still waiting on the full VeloResults count and the observer report before I believe anything. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 12. Kito TV says the court ordered supervised access to the servers and logs for both sides. Good. Let the petition run its course with the scrutiny it needs. Doesn't mean it's rigged, just that they're checking. Whatever the outcome, I'll take the official result over the loudest headline 🚕 #VelorianElection

Day 12. Two stories today: VBC's 'riot in Kessa' clip, and the Court ordering supervised access to the commission's servers and logs for both sides. Don't judge the riot from one clip, check the original source and timestamps. The court order is the real news here. Let the audit do its job and read the findings when they're published. #VelorianElection

Day 12. Kito TV says the Civic Front petition got the Supreme Court to order supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. Good. Whatever the logs show, that's how it should be checked. Patience, friends. Let the process run. #VelorianElection
